honor: Chevalier (Knight) of the Ordre national de la Légion d'honneur
awarded_by: French Republic (decree of 31 December 2021, published in the 1 January 2022 promotion)
detail: Appointed Chevalier of the Légion d'honneur in the New Year promotion (decree of 31 December 2021), recognising decades of service as a local elected official and his commitment to rural France. The insignia were formally presented to him on 14 April 2023 by former Prime Minister Jean Castex.
